items.caption: Hungary’s Tímea Nagy won Olympic individual epee gold in Sydney in 2000 and defended her title in Athens in 2004. After reversing a retirement announcement, she became individual world champion in 2006. This portrait comes from a 2013 ceremony in Budapest.
Elite FC Winter Camp 2026 schedule graphic (Dec. 27–31).
items.note: Same graphic first extracted from the Oct 22 ‘Winter Camp Schedule!’ Mailchimp (identical bytes). Re-extracted from the Nov 10 reminder. Club logo at the bottom is part of the graphic.

items.caption: Club Winter Camp 2026 photo flyer from the Nov. 10 newsletter. Dates Dec. 27–31, 9:30 a.m.–2 p.m.; activities match the known list. The email does not identify who is pictured.

items.caption: Youth medalists on the podium at the Kiefer Meinhardt Cup. Mila Siu of Elite FC is at far right, holding her Youth 14 bronze; the other medalists are from other clubs and are not named here.
items.alt: A group of youth fencers on the second- and third-place podium at the Kiefer Meinhardt Cup. Mila Siu stands at far right holding a bronze medal.
items.note: Landscape 640x480. Extracted from the same newsletter but not used in No. 7 proof v1: Frank asked for the two-girl photo (Mila and Stella) and the Penny photo. This frame is a wider podium group; Stella is not clearly identifiable, and the other medalists are not named in the club email. Held for Frank if he wants it. Image normalized (EXIF orientation applied, saved as JPEG) so printed pixels match the displayed frame; not cropped.

items.caption: A fencer in white epee kit on the strip at a USA Fencing event, from the club's Nov. 23 newsletter congratulating Nico Ng on a top-16 finish at the November NAC in Columbus. A younger boy in street clothes stands in front of him; a referee sits behind a USA Fencing banner. The email does not name the people in the photo.
items.alt: A fencer in a white epee uniform stands on a strip in a convention-hall venue, holding a water bottle, with a USA Fencing banner on the table behind him and a boy in a blue shirt facing him.
items.note: Portrait 1500x2000. Extracted from the Mon Nov 23 club Mailchimp (allowlisted). Email does not identify the fencer; the same letter congratulates Nico Ng's NAC top-16. Ask Frank to confirm it is Nico before a named caption. A boy in a blue shirt and a referee are also in the frame and are not named. EXIF orientation applied, saved as JPEG; not cropped.

items.caption: Christina Jiang of Elite FC stands on the first-place box after winning Youth 12 Women's Epee at Freehold Fencing Academy's November Youth Foil & Epee. The other medalists are from other clubs and are not named here.
items.alt: Four youth fencers on a podium at Freehold Fencing Academy, with Christina Jiang on the first-place box under a Freehold Fencing Academy banner and an American flag.
